title: Hearty Healthy Italian Wholemeal Flour Lasagna
description: A slow-cooked, anti-inflammatory-friendly lasagna featuring strong wholemeal flour and a floral cheese-pull, with a light polish finish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper, and mix well.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the mushroom mixture.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the tomato sauce, the remaining ricotta cheese mixture, and finally the remaining mushroom mixture.
Top the lasagna with the grated parmesan cheese and chopped basil.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
